description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for command strategy implementations related to connectivity commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It manages validation, exception handling, and provides a common structure for specific connectivity command strategies.

classes.name: AbstractConnectivityCommandStrategy
classes.description: Abstract base class for handling connectivity commands with common validation and exception handling logic.

methods.name: AbstractConnectivityCommandStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the command strategy with the specific command class type.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Indicates that this strategy is always defined for given commands.

methods.name: calculateRelativeMetadata
methods.description: Calculates optional metadata relative to the connectivity entity, default implementation returns empty.

methods.name: notAccessible
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that the connection is not accessible.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the connection state and command, returns an exception if validation fails.

methods.name: handleValidationException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during validation, logs details, and converts to a DittoRuntimeException.

methods.name: toDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Converts a throwable into a DittoRuntimeException, wrapping specific connection failure exceptions.
